LanguageData.Goji_Setting_ZeroCostArchite_Description: If checked, all non-vanilla Archite genes will have their metabolism cost set to 0. Original values are restored when unchecked.
LanguageData.Goji_Setting_DisableHussar_Description: If checked, the modification to Vanilla Races Expanded - Hussar weapon aptitude gene metabolism costs will be disabled. Requires restart.
LanguageData.Goji_Setting_DisableFungoid_Description: If checked, the Vanilla Races Expanded - Fungoid telepathy interaction patches will be disabled. Requires restart.
LanguageData.Goji_Setting_DisablePhytokin_Description: If checked, the Vanilla Races Expanded - Phytokin green thumb pruning thought patch will be disabled. Requires restart.
LanguageData.Goji_TelepathyRitualRequiresAllCarriers: All participants must have the telepathy gene to be able to communicate with the speaker.
LanguageData.Goji_KeenReflexes_Value: Melee dodge applies to ranged attacks
LanguageData.Goji_KeenReflexes_Description: Converts melee dodge chance to ranged dodge chance at 1:1 ratio
LanguageData.Goji_JinxedBloodline_QualityFactor_Toolt: Carriers of jinxed bloodline disturb the psychic forces around them, reducing ritual power by 10% per carrier participating.
LanguageData.Goji_MessageImprintedOn: {BABY_labelShort} has imprinted on {FEEDER_labelShort}, recognising {FEEDER_objective} as {BABY_possessive} sole parent.
LanguageData.Goji_MessageImprintedTraitCopied: {CHILD_labelShort} has learned from {PARENT_labelShort} and acquired the trait: {TRAIT}.
LanguageData.Goji_Imprint_Desc: Carriers of this gene form a lasting bond with the first person to feed them, recognising that person as their sole parent. They learn by watching and imitating their parent, taking on one of their traits at age 3.
